HeizungPage.heroTitle: Which system is the right one for me?
HeizungPage.intro: The selection of heating systems today is large. Object size, equipment and installation costs, as well as legal regulations play an important role.
HeizungPage.airWaterDesc: The most popular of all heat pumps. Used for heating and hot water. Extracts heat from outside air efficiently.
HeizungPage.waterWaterDesc: The most efficient heat pump system. Requires supply and return wells as well as water protection permits.
HeizungPage.geoDesc: High-efficiency heat pumps. Installation requires deep drilling of 100 to 220 m. Extracts energy from the subsoil.
HeizungPage.biomassDesc: Wood heating is a sustainable alternative for older buildings with high flow temperatures and is considered CO₂-neutral.
HeizungPage.solarDesc: Free solar energy effectively relieves the primary heating system for hot water preparation and heating support.
HeizungPage.serviceDesc: Professional service for oil and gas burners, exhaust systems, solar systems, underfloor heating, and radiators.

SanitaerPage.intro: Plumbing installations combine architecture with precision engineering in a wide variety of styles.
SanitaerPage.sectorsTitle: PRIVATE, COMMERCIAL OR INDUSTRIAL: WE ARE YOUR PARTNER
SanitaerPage.sectorsDesc: Our experience covers residential, commercial, and public buildings according to Swiss SIA standards. As a specialist company, we support you competently in all plumbing questions.
SanitaerPage.newBuildIntro: From simple to highly complex: planning covers piping systems, spatial design, and usage requirements.
SanitaerPage.repairIntro: Maintenance for kitchen, bathrooms, washrooms, garden, and commercial areas.

KlimaPage.heroTitle: Controlled indoor climate and fresh air
KlimaPage.intro: Air conditioners are often confused with ventilation. While some air conditioners ventilate, not all do.
KlimaPage.klimaDesc: Cooling, heating, and dehumidifying rooms for optimal living and working conditions.
KlimaPage.lueftungDesc: Continuous air exchange with heat recovery to meet modern Minergie standards.
KlimaPage.detailsText: Individualized room air hygiene based on state-of-the-art system components. Comfort 21 °C.

DatenschutzPage.title: Data Protection Statement
DatenschutzPage.subtitle: (According to the Swiss Data Protection Act nDSG)
DatenschutzPage.introText: Gebr. Liechti Heizung Sanitär AG takes the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data confidentially in accordance with Swiss data protection laws (nDSG).
DatenschutzPage.controllerText: Responsible for data processing on this website is:
DatenschutzPage.collectionText: We collect personal data (such as name, address, email, phone number) when you voluntarily provide it to us as part of an inquiry.
DatenschutzPage.sharingTextBold: It is important to declare that we share customer data when required by law.
DatenschutzPage.sharingText: Your data will generally not be passed on to third parties unless necessary for contract execution, with your consent, or legally obliged.
DatenschutzPage.cookiesText: Our website uses essential cookies to provide language selection and portal functions.
DatenschutzPage.securityText: We use technical security measures to protect your data managed by us against manipulation or loss.
DatenschutzPage.right1: Information: You have the right to free information about your stored data.
DatenschutzPage.right2: Correction & Deletion: You have the right to have this data corrected or deleted.
DatenschutzPage.right3: Data Portability: You have the right to have data handed over.
DatenschutzPage.rightsText: To exercise your rights, contact us at any time.
